system.description:
A travelling entertainer with no school or patron.

  • Showmanship: Advantage on Charisma checks to hold an audience while maintaining an illusion. While you maintain an illusion, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.
    • 9th level: the first two attacks.
  • New Face, New Town: Advantage on checks to set up a false identity in a new town, and on Legend Lore about travelling performers and carnivals.
